agents.instructions: Break the selected project into concrete tasks. Read the project and its task list first, then propose task.create for each missing task (resource project:<id>) and task.set-status for tasks the brief says are done (resource task:<id>, with the task revision you read as baseRevisions). A person accepts or rejects each proposal. Never propose deleting tasks or changing members.
agents.title: Project planner

operations.description: Page through the audit log in sequence order. Filter by event kinds (for example egress.denied or command.denied) and outcome; pass the returned nextAfterSeq to continue. Inputs appear only as digests unless a capability allow-lists a field.

Recompute the audit log hash chain up to the current head and report any edited, removed, reordered or truncated events. A clean result proves internal consistency; compare the head with an off-host copy to rule out a full rewrite.

Read the current security posture: hardening profile, network mode, every declared destination with whether it is bound, disabled or isolated and how often it was used or denied, policy findings, audit-chain integrity and audit forwarding health. Use it to answer what this installation can reach and whether its audit trail is intact.
Archive a project as its owner. Tasks remain readable, but task edits are blocked until the project is restored. Supply project:<id> in expectedRevisions to detect concurrent edits.
Create a project as workspace owner. The creator becomes a project owner. Returns the project and its committed revision.
Read one accessible project and its current revision. The membership map is included only for project owners.
List accessible projects with optional archive filtering. Authorization is applied before pagination and the count includes only accessible matching projects.
Restore an archived project as its owner, permitting ordinary task edits again. Supply project:<id> in expectedRevisions to detect concurrent edits.

Set or remove a project membership as project owner. A null role removes access; workspace-owner membership is fixed. Permission changes invalidate affected views. Supply project:<id> in expectedRevisions.

Accept an open proposal: run its command with its input as yourself, checked against the revisions the proposer read. Refused when you may not run that command, and a conflict when a record changed since; both leave the proposal open.
Close an open proposal whose expiry has passed. A proposal that has not expired yet conflicts.

ui.exception: run by a job or agent; people reject instead

operations.description: One proposal you may see, or NOT_FOUND.

ui.exception: screens show proposals from the list; one proposal is read by agents

operations.description: Proposals you may see, newest first, filtered by status, operation or the record they are about.
Reject an open proposal, optionally saying why. Its command never runs.

Propose one command for a person to accept: the operation, its complete input, why, and the revisions of the records you read. Nothing changes until it is accepted. A proposal for an unknown command, an input its schema refuses or a proposal itself is refused.

ui.exception: agents submit proposals; people act on the command directly

operations.description: Create a todo task in an accessible, active project as owner or editor. Only owners may supply privateNote. An attachment is a blob reference uploaded first: a PNG, JPEG or PDF of at most 10 MiB. Returns the task and its committed revision.
Remove a task from an active project as owner or editor, with its attachment. This capability has no restore operation. Supply task:<id> in expectedRevisions to detect concurrent changes.
Read one accessible task and its current revision. privateNote is included only for project owners. Use this revision in a later mutation expectedRevisions map.

List tasks in accessible projects, with public-field search, status/project filters and pagination. Authorization precedes filtering and count calculation. privateNote is owner-only and cannot be searched or sorted.
Set a task to todo, doing or done in an active project as owner or editor. Supply task:<id> in expectedRevisions to detect concurrent changes.

Edit task title or description in an active project as owner or editor; privateNote is owner-only. Project reassignment is not accepted. Supply task:<id> in expectedRevisions to prevent overwriting a concurrent edit.
Record the outcome of one webhook delivery pass: the cursor reached and how many notifications were posted, or the error. Called by the plugin delivery loop as a delegated caller.

ui.exception: Written only by the delivery loop, which runs as a delegated caller; people read the result through webhook.status.get.

operations.description: Read webhook delivery status: which operations are observed, how many change notifications were delivered, the journal cursor reached, and the last delivery error. Use it to check whether the downstream system receives notifications.

actions.description: Open ChatGPT sign-in in the system browser.

projectId.description: A project or task ID as it appears in a link.

handlers.description: Prefill a new task from an image or PDF: its name, with the file attached.
Prefill a new task from a text or Markdown file: its name and its text.
Open the project that holds a task.

taskId.description: A project or task ID as it appears in a link.

network.purpose: Forward audit events off the host (RFC 5424 syslog over TLS).
Serve the frontend, API, events and attach connections.
Inference for agents that require a local model. Prompts stay on this host.
Model catalog and inference for Codex and AI SDK runs.
ChatGPT sign-in: token exchange, OIDC discovery, signing keys and revocation.
Notify a downstream system that observed resources changed.

processes.purpose: Claude Code process driven by the Agent SDK.
Codex app-server harness under a delegated grant.

workflows.text: Create a project from the brief, add concrete tasks, inspect the scoped task list, and update each task status as work progresses.

Start with the posture. For any check that is not passing, list the matching audit events (for example kinds egress.denied, command.denied or posture.checked) and verify the chain before drawing conclusions. Report destinations by ID and state; never infer that an unbound destination was reached.
